report.title: Autonomous Industrial Resilience and the Pathway to Tool-Chain Closure: A Framework for Self-Sustaining Machine Ecologies
report.summary: The transition of a highly automated facility from a human-tended outpost into a self-sustaining machine ecology represents one of the most profound engineering thresholds in the evolution of complex systems.
